description: Local verification cases for nexitally-node-parser.js. Inputs are sanitized fixtures, not live subscriptions.

cases.name: full-config
cases.notes: Extracts AnyTLS nodes from a full Quantumult X profile and drops traffic, expiry, Premium, and duplicate lines.

cases.name: full-config-crlf-bom
cases.notes: Same as full-config, but saved with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings.

cases.name: duplicates-and-meta
cases.notes: Comments, blank lines, metadata keywords, and exact duplicates are removed. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.

cases.name: mixed-protocols
cases.notes: Keeps anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, and socks5. Drops hysteria2, wireguard, and unknown schemes.

cases.name: section-boundaries
cases.notes: Stops reading at the next INI section so nodes pasted under [policy] or [filter_local] cannot leak.

cases.name: case-and-header-variants
cases.notes: Section header and protocol names are matched case-insensitively. A trailing [server_local] with no following section is valid.

cases.name: missing-server-local
cases.notes: A profile without [server_local] fails closed instead of returning an empty resource.

cases.name: comments-only
cases.notes: Commented server lines are not uncommented.
